description: This Java class implements a BackupAgent for an Android application that manages backup and restore operations for multiple separate data records within the application's backup data set. It stores application state including an integer and two booleans, handling incremental backup by only updating changed records.

classes.name: MultiRecordExampleAgent
classes.description: An Android BackupAgent subclass that manages multi-record backup and restore operations, tracking individual pieces of application data with separate keys, supporting incremental updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the agent by setting the application's data file location.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Performs backup of application data, saving only changed records based on previous state, improving efficiency.

methods.name: writeStateFile
methods.description: Writes the current application data state to the backup state file.

methods.name: writeBackupEntity
methods.description: Helper method to write a single data record to backup output under a specific key.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Restores application data from backup, reconstructing individual data pieces and overwriting current data.
